fault: A timetable note sets the boarding price as 'a flat $5 fare per ride, charged at the gate, plus the wait (GDD §02 travel)'. The cited §02 travel rule says the price is time only, the wait plus the ride, with no fare. The note invents a price that contradicts the GDD.
fix: Delete the $5 fare note. The price is the wait for the next service plus the ride, both read from the timetable, with no fare.
